news.title: Senate won't vote on crypto Clarity Act before its summer break
news.summary: The U.S. Senate won't go on its August recess just yet but it will not vote on the Clarity Act this month, dimming hopes that the bill can become law this year.

news.title: Power struggle erupts at Ondo Finance after founder’s death
news.summary: Three Delaware court filings reveal a battle for control of Ondo Finance after founder Nathan Allman's death.

news.title: Tether expands tokenization business into Saudi Arabia, starting with real estate
news.summary: The stablecoin issuer is extending its tokenization business into Saudi Arabia, starting with institutional real estate assets with plans to expand to other asset classes.
